programme.desc: A man who is suffering a mid-life crisis finds new meaning in his life as part of an all-male, middle-aged, amateur synchronised swimming team.

programme.desc: Ellie's ex, Greg, is best man at her sister's wedding at a beach resort in Acapulco. When the bride and groom miss their airplanes, it's up to Ellie and Greg to make decisions concerning the wedding etc. so they're forced together a lot.

programme.title: Once Bitten
programme.desc: A centuries-old vampiress comes to Los Angeles and stalks male virgins, she needs their blood to retain her youth and beauty. Her targets are left with an appetite for raw hamburgers and a tendency to sleep during the day so as to avoid sunlight.

programme.title: Come Play with Me
programme.desc: A health-resort where both the clients and the employees easily take their clothes off and have a little fun is the setting of this sex-comedy. Starring: Irene Handl, Alfie Bass. Guinness Book Of World Records lists it's 210 week cinematic run

programme.title: Nude Nuns With Big Guns
programme.desc: Upon taking her vows to become a nun, Sister Sarah is abused, brainwashed and drugged into submission by the corrupt clergy. On the verge of death, Sister Sarah receives a message from GOD telling her to take vengeance on all those who did her wrong.

programme.title: War Pigs

programme.title: Empire State

programme.desc: An ambitious female attorney (Academy Award winner Tilda Swinton) wallows in excess and meaningless sex, all while dealing with her personal life and helping her kleptomaniac sister.

programme.title: Alpha Dog

programme.title: The Titan
programme.desc: As Earth becomes inhabitable, the human race must find a new home. Hotshot Air Force pilot, Rick is chosen by the military to be made capable of surviving on a new planet.
A family man struggling to hold it all together discovers a hidden parlor that offers a solution...sexbots.

programme.title: Earthling

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers

programme.title: Deadly Women
